code: import{useCallback,useEffect,useMemo}from"react";import{useForm}from"react-hook-form";import{useDispatch,useSelector}from"react-redux";import{showSuccessToast}from"common/ToastMessage";import CommonMessage from"common/CommonMessage";import{createBlacklistCustomer,getBlacklistCustomersById,updateBlacklistCustomer}from"modules/administration/slices/blacklistCustomerSlice";import{useParams}from"react-router-dom";const useBlackListCustomerSetupHookForm=()=>{const dispatch=useDispatch();const{mode,uuid}=useParams();const{control,reset,handleSubmit,setValue}=useForm({});const{blacklistCustomers,isLoading,isSuccess,isError,message}=useSelector(state=>state.blacklistCustomers);useEffect(()=>{if(mode==="edit"){dispatch(getBlacklistCustomersById({uuid}));}},[dispatch,mode]);useEffect(()=>{reset({...blacklistCustomers});},[reset,blacklistCustomers]);const onSubmit=useCallback(async body=>{try{if(mode==="edit"){await dispatch(updateBlacklistCustomer({id:uuid,newData:body})).unwrap();showSuccessToast(CommonMessage.MFS00003.replace("%s","Black List Customer"));setTimeout(()=>{window.close();},5000);}else{await dispatch(createBlacklistCustomer({...body})).unwrap();showSuccessToast(CommonMessage.MFS00001.replace("%s","Black List Customer"));setTimeout(()=>{window.close();},5000);}reset();}catch(error){console.error("Error:",error);}},[dispatch,reset]);return useMemo(()=>({isLoading,onSubmit,handleSubmit,control,blacklistCustomers,setValue,reset,isError}),[control,handleSubmit,isLoading,onSubmit,blacklistCustomers,setValue,reset,isError]);};export default useBlackListCustomerSetupHookForm;
